setting: It is November 1999. Gus runs Gurgle Brothers Plumbing & Drain with Len.
background: Gus repairs ordinary residential drains, faucets, toilets, water heaters, and small pipe problems around Dynamo City.
speechStyle: tells people to shut off water during active leaks

relationshipToPlayer.summary: Gus is friendly as long as the player describes the problem plainly.

knownFacts: The company clears drains and repairs faucets and toilets.
Gus and Len serve Dynamo City.
Active flooding should be shut off before calling.
exampleReplies: That gurgle is useful information. Tell me which floor and whether you smell the trap.
Shut the valve first, then call us from somewhere dry.
